name: com.pg.telekinesis
description: Telekinesis: grab, hold, rotate, push away and throw physical objects with the camera aim. Needs com.pg.localization-system and com.pg.menu. Takes things to a bag, gives physics to loot and re-homes dropped things through TelekinesisBridge (hooks the game implements).
author: Lucia Lunadottir

samples.description: Telekinesis takes items to the bag through TelekinesisBridge. Needs com.pg.inventory-system. After import remove the .txt from the file name.
